tips: not only A but also B = B 是递进重点，比 A 更值得记录。

back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Both economic growth and social equity are necessary conditions for sustainable development; neither alone is sufficient to achieve long-term prosperity for all citizens.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：Both A and B = 两者并列且缺一不可；neither alone = 单独均不充分。② 核心规律：CET6 both...neither 并列否定结构 = 两者必须协同，不可偏废，是综合论证的核心逻辑。③ 验证与迁移：答案方向应反映 both are required；选项 "only economic growth matters" = 错误，"both are insufficient" = 也错误。
tips: both A and B are necessary = 偏废任何一方均不可，答案体现 "协同" 的必要性。
neither alone is sufficient = "单独不够" 是对 both 的强化逻辑支撑，是答案关键的补充。

analysis.text: ① 识别信号：Both A and B = 两者并列且缺一不可；neither alone = 单独均不充分。② 核心规律：CET6 both...neither 并列否定结构 = 两者必须协同，不可偏废，是综合论证的核心逻辑。③ 验证与迁移：答案方向应反映 both are required；选项 "only economic growth matters" = 错误，"both are insufficient" = 也错误。
tips: both A and B are necessary = 偏废任何一方均不可，答案体现 "协同" 的必要性。
neither alone is sufficient = "单独不够" 是对 both 的强化逻辑支撑，是答案关键的补充。

back_content.text: 结论：三项技能被定位为核心能力而非补充技能（not merely...but = 递进升格）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The speaker argued that digital literacy, critical thinking, and collaborative problem-solving are not merely supplementary skills but core competencies that every graduate must possess in the modern economy.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：three parallel skills + "not merely supplementary...but core" = 并列递进的升格定义。② 核心规律：not merely A but B = CET6 并列递进的升格结构，A 是被否定的旧认知，B 是说话人主张的更高定位。③ 验证与迁移：答案方向：these are core, not just supplementary competencies；与选项 "nice to have skills" 相对。
tips: not merely...but = 升格递进，后面的定位更高，是答案核心。
三个并列名词后跟 are A 的属性 = 全部同属一个类别，答案体现集体属性。

back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The foundation has expanded its work across three continents, partnering with local NGOs, training community health workers, and establishing renewable energy micro-grids in underserved regions.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：三个现在分词并列（partnering / training / establishing）= 三项工作内容平行列举。② 核心规律：CET6 并列现在分词列举 = 每项工作地位相等，常考 "which of the following is mentioned"。③ 验证与迁移：如问 "what work does the foundation do" = 选含所有三项内容（或其中一项具体内容）的选项。
tips: 现在分词并列列举时，每个 -ing 短语都是一個独立的工作内容，全部有效。
如果面试问 "which was NOT mentioned" = 找不在三项中的描述，是排除法。

back_content.text: 结论：三项并列优势：①决策贴近社区 ②更快响应本地需求 ③减少中央机构行政负担。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The advantages of decentralized governance are threefold: it brings decision-making closer to communities, it enables faster responses to local needs, and it reduces the administrative burden on central institutions.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："advantages are threefold" + colon = 正式并列结构标注（三点展开），后接分号列举。② 核心规律：CET6 官方陈述结构："N-fold" 或 "three aspects/dimensions" + colon = 明确标注列举数量，后接全部答案。③ 验证与迁移：如问 "which advantage is mentioned" = 从三项中选题目对应的那项；如问 "how many" = 答案 threefold = three。
tips: "threefold/fourfold" + colon = 几点并列，后面完整展开，每点都是可考查项目。
分号 + it/they 结构 = 每个独立分句是一个并列要点，同等重要。
